messages.subject: ucdavisthesis: Lyx layout for LaTeX package
parts:
Hi everyone

I know this is not directly related to R, but as R geeks are likely to use LaTeX, I thought I would share this here in case that can help someone!

If you want to write your dissertation in LaTeX and use the package ucdavisthesis, but want to use the nice GUI Lyx, I wrote a corresponding lyx layout for ucdavisthesis. That will help you use all the enhanced graphical features of Lyx while writing in plain TeX and having the UC Davis required formatting.

Best,
Matthieu
